The closest receptors on the existing alignment from the edge of pavement is presently five (5) feet within the segment of roadway from Chicago Road to Ashland Avenue and one hundred (100) feet within the segment of roadway from Main Street to U.S. 54.
The nearest receptor for the proposed improvement for Lincoln Highway is also five (5) feet within the segment of roadway from Chicago Road to Ashland Avenue. Within the segment of roadway from Main Street to U.S. 54, the nearest receptor for the proposed improvement is forty (40) feet.
The Federal ambient air quality standards are 35 PPM for one-hour maximum concentration and 9 PPM for eight-hour maximum concentration, both of which are not to be exceeded more than once per year.
Therefore, since the implementation of this highway proposal is not anticipated to have a significant air quality impact, comments on the consistency of the highway proposal with the approved State Implementation Plan are not necessary from the cognizant air pollution control agency in accordance with proposed PPM 90-7; of August 21, 1973.
